methodology:
REA Holdings operates entirely in East Kalimantan with 3 CPO mills. Total ~75K hectares allocation, half planted (~37,500 ha = 92.6K acres planted base).

3-row breakdown refined from previous 2-row:
- Mature with-mill cluster (50K acres / ~20K ha): premium $5,500/acre
- Immature/young plantings (15K acres / ~6K ha): mid-discount during development
- Plasma + unplanted concession (27.6K acres / ~11K ha): full concession discount

Net debt of $159M is meaningful. The 2024 CDM disposal to Teladan Prima Agro provides a useful in-portfolio mark.
